**Finding: MINCOMMIT — compliant (preferred level).**

- **No commitment language exists**: targeted searches for "minimum", "commit", "shortfall", "volume", "take or pay" returned nothing operative against Customer.
- **§4.1 Charges (p0052)** ties Charges strictly to Services specified in Order Forms/Service Option Attachments, billed as one-time, installment, recurring or usage — i.e. usage or ordered Services only.
- **§11.5 Capacity Planning (p0142)** is a Customer-discretion provision (Customer decides and requests capacity), not a capacity commitment.
- **Exits exist**: §3.4 monthly convenience termination and §13.1 termination without termination charges on IBM price/term changes, so no multi-year take-or-pay lock-in.

Noted in the rationale rather than flagged: §3.4(b)'s "early termination charges, if any" (a T4C exit-cost issue, not double-flagged here), and the need to confirm that the Order Forms/Attachment A — not part of these Base Terms — contain no committed volumes or minimum monthly charges.
